Name: Discord Clipboard Send
Author: CaviarTheCatgirl
Description: Send what's on your clipboard (files, an image or text) to a list of Discord people with one key: tap to send, double-tap to send as spoiler, with an optional confirmation. Needs the ClipboardSendDeck Vencord plugin.

Actions.Name: Clipboard Send
Actions.Tooltip: Sends the clipboard to the people on this key. Default: tap = send, double tap = send as spoiler, hold = show what's on the clipboard.
